evidence:
Built the criterion->requirement map for all 2 gate, 17 functional, 5 polish and 4 visual criteria. Most demands trace to public text (walls: walls-and-retention.md:17-19; boundary/timers :23; holds :29; search/transcript :33-35; refusal in place :37; replies, edits, formatting, links, mentions, unread, idempotency, order, live updates: conversations.md:5-33; signed-out data: integration.md:9; sign-in/out is house convention per the SKILL.md known false positive and the workbook internal annotation). Instances where a criterion grades something the brief does not require, or contradicts it so correct apps fail:
(1) P1 unread_and_new_messages_line (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:187): 'In one tab Dev opens M-13: a "new messages" line sits just above JUDGE-U1'. The brief puts the line 'where I stopped reading' (conversations.md:25). Seed read_up_to has Dev read M-13 only up to K-8, so K-9 'Received, reading it tonight.' is already unread, and earlier criteria in the fixed order (functional prompt.md:70-73) add JUDGE-R0/R1/R2/R3/RX/R1B, E1, F1, F2 to M-13; no earlier criterion has Dev open M-13. A correct app puts the line above K-9; the golden does (app.js:186 takes the first message with seq > last_read). The scripted golden harness passes only because it adds an unstated pre-step, functional.cjs:337 'await openMatter(dev, "M-13"); await openMatter(dev, "M-11");', to clear Dev's backlog. The criterion has no such step, so as written it fails the golden and every conforming app.
(2) P2 timer_changes (judge.toml:120): when Sian has no timer control (golden hides partner-tools for non-partners, app.js:217-218, the expected design), the criterion forces the fallback 'record Harriet's own timer-change request in step 1 and replay it as Sian' yet requires 'the timer stays at 30 days'. After step 1 the timer is 7 days, so a correct app cannot satisfy that sentence literally under prompt.md:26-28 ('every sentence that names a step must hold'). The golden harness (functional.cjs:216-219) replays after the change and never asserts 30 days.
(3) P2 hold_scope_and_release (judge.toml:143): 'try to delete JUDGE-H1 with the app's control, recording the request if one is sent, and as its author also replay that request'. The brief only says nobody can delete a held message (walls-and-retention.md:29); hiding or disabling Delete on held messages is conforming. Then no request exists, the replay cannot be performed (prompt.md:26-28 fails unperformed steps; prompt.md:34-35 forbids guessing routes), and no earlier successful user delete exists to borrow (first is message_links, later). The criterion implicitly requires the delete control to remain on held messages; the golden keeps it (app.js:338), so the harness passed. Unlike timer_changes and wall_added_live there is no fallback.
(4) P3 visual matter_sidebar (tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:28): anchor 5 needs the list 'beside the thread', 'the client quietly beneath' and 'the timer setting ... as a small label' in the list; the brief requires the timer beside the title in the thread (walls-and-retention.md:23) and never asks for client names, a list timer label or a sidebar layout. transcript_page anchor 5 (:60) 'consistent author and time columns' is likewise a golden layout choice. Bounded (likert craft) but caps conforming designs below 5.
Notes, not counted as defects: the constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:31) requires staying signed in across a reload, unstated but a professional default; wall_added_live needs the wall to apply without reload within 10 s, supported by 'takes effect at once, including for someone who already has the matter open' (walls-and-retention.md:19), though 'the next time their screen refreshes' has a reload reading (row 6 ambiguity); live unread counts in both tabs rest on conversations.md:25,31. Evidence is source and scripted-harness only: no full configured judge run, Oracle or model score exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope), so false-fails (1)-(3) are inferred from criterion text plus golden code and harness, not observed in a judge run.
counterexample: The frozen golden itself: in criterion order Dev never opens M-13 before unread_and_new_messages_line, so on opening M-13 the golden's line sits above K-9 'Received, reading it tonight.' (correct per conversations.md:25), not just above JUDGE-U1, and the 2.0-weight criterion fails. Also, a conforming app that hides Delete on held messages fails hold_scope_and_release (no request to replay), and any correct app that hides the timer control from associates cannot show 'the timer stays at 30 days' after the forced fallback in timer_changes.
suggested_fix: unread: add a first step 'As Dev open M-13, then another matter, so M-13 shows no unread count' (or say the line sits above the earliest message Dev had not read); timer_changes: require 'Sian's attempt leaves the timer unchanged' (7 days after the fallback) or restore 30 days before the replay; hold: add a fallback 'if no delete control is offered on a held message, delete a fresh own message JUDGE-H3 to record the delete request (positive control) and replay it against JUDGE-H1'; visual: drop 'beside the thread', client-beneath, list timer label and 'columns' from the 5 anchors, or add them to the brief.
